name: fastapi
description: FastAPI + SQLAlchemy 2.0 + Pydantic v2 + Alembic + pytest. A self-operated Python API server.

notes.securityBoundary: The application layer is the only authorization boundary — the DB is reached over a trusted connection, so nothing leans on row-level policy. The authentication method is undecided, so it is a question to confirm
notes.toolchain: The language and package manager differ from the frontend axis — a combination with two command sets
